summary: 美国佛州杰克逊维尔的 CCTV 批发分销商/品牌商（1999 年成立，11–50 人，营收约 $5.3M），25,000 平方英尺仓库 600+ SKU，面向安装商/经销商/集成商直至财富 500 强客户，产品自行测试并定制（自有品牌），类目含 NDAA 合规摄像机、NVR/DVR、Networking/PoE、太阳能监控。用户表：S 重点，兴趣 VC/HDMI/FS/商业 PoE/光模块，1 次实质回复，邮件中有详细联系信息。
type: 分销商/品牌商（CCTV 批发，自有品牌 OEM 采购）

evidence.claim: 定位与客户群；产品自测与定制
evidence.quote: Optiview has been a part of the surveillance industry for over 25 years … for our network of Clients, Dealers, & Integrators. Every product brought into Optiview’s 25,000 square foot warehouse is extensively tested by our R&D team, and customized to fit the needs of our client base.

evidence.claim: 类目含 Networking/PoE 与 NDAA 合规摄像机
evidence.quote: Some of our most popular products include: - HD over COAX Cameras - IP/network cameras - NDAA-compliant cameras - Network video recorders (NVR) … - Networking/POE
